name: Kanao Tsuyuri
summary: After completing the Hashira Training, Kanao became one of the strongest young Demon Slayers. She possesses exceptional physical abilities, swordsmanship, eyesight, and reaction speed. During the final battles, she fought alongside Inosuke against Doma and later helped restore Tanjiro after his transformation into a demon. Her mastery of Flower Breathing and her final technique, Equinoctial Vermilion Eye, allow her to dramatically enhance her perception at the cost of her eyesight.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Flower Breathing

weaknesses: Equinoctial Vermilion Eye severely damages her eyesight and can potentially leave her blind
notes: Kanao's Post-Hashira Training key. Her Equinoctial Vermilion Eye dramatically enhances her visual perception and allows her to perceive the movements of extremely fast opponents, but causes severe strain and permanent damage to her eyesight.
